name: Baked Balance-n-Brighten Color Correcting Foundation, 09 Toffee
editorialDescription: A baked powder foundation made in Italy. The formula starts as a cream and is baked into a marbled, multi-tone pan that blends into one colour as you buff it on. It's the brand's signature base and comes in nine shades; this listing is 09 Toffee, one of the deeper ones. Coverage builds from sheer to medium with a natural matte finish, which suits people who like powder but not a heavy, cakey look.
keyFeatures: Baked powder foundation made in Italy (country of origin on the listing)
Marbled multi-tone pan intended to even out redness and uneven tone
Nine shades on laurageller.com: Porcelain, Fair, Light, Medium, Golden Medium, Sand, Tan, Deep and Toffee
The listing names centella asiatica, vitamin E, green tea extract and jojoba oil
Buildable coverage, matte finish, compact packaging
advantages: Powder format is quick to apply and easy to carry
Buildable: one layer for light coverage, more for medium
A long-running product, so swatches and shade comparisons are easy to find
disadvantages: Nine shades is a narrow range, with few options for deep skin tones
Powder can emphasize dry patches or texture on very dry skin
Listing wording such as 'dermatologist-approved', 'safe for rosacea' and 'never settles into fine lines' is the brand's claim; patch-test if your skin is reactive
suits: People who prefer powder foundation with light-to-medium coverage
Normal, combination or oily skin that looks best with a matte finish
Anyone whose shade match is 09 Toffee
skipIf: You need full coverage or a dewy finish
Your skin is very dry or flaky
Your shade falls outside the nine-shade range
buyingConsiderations: Use Laura Geller's online shade finder before ordering; this ASIN is 09 Toffee only
Check that the seller is Laura Geller New York to avoid old or counterfeit stock
Read the full ingredient list on the box if you have sensitivities
